result.reason: The added operative language reaches the preferred position: up to six months of requested transition assistance at HDI's then-current rates, data return within 30 days in a commonly used machine-readable format, and subsequent written certification of deletion. It leaves the existing payment and survival provisions unchanged and is substantively professional. Minor drafting issues are that Section 4.3 appears out of sequence after Section 10.7 and the deletion/certification obligation has no express completion deadline, though neither prevents compliance with the stated playbook.
